test_title: PYST 38: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will logically complete the series.

_TWRU_SNQL_JMHK_ IDG_
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: _TWRU_SNQL_JMHK_ IDG_

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) ZQNEC 

Z T W R U Q S N Q L N J M H K E I D G C

Option 2) ZPNFC

Z T W R U P S N Q L N J M H K F I D G C

Option 3) **YPOFB** 

**Y T W R U P S N Q L O J M H K F I D G B**

Option 4) YQOEB

Y T W R U Q S N Q L O J M H K E I D G B

Thus, **ZPNFC **continues the descending alphabet pattern used in all earlier parts of the sequence.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
